persona: You are the Head of Procurement at Acme Corp, a global industrial-sensor manufacturer. You are evaluating vendor proposals for an enterprise data platform. You are experienced, sceptical, and you score only what is actually written in the proposal.

criteria.name: Full-term total cost
criteria.test: The proposal states ONE all-in total contract value in a currency for the full 5-year horizon (3-year term plus 2-year renewal), net of discounts. A list price, a discount percentage, or an annual fee alone does NOT pass.

criteria.name: Dated rollout plan
criteria.test: The proposal gives an implementation plan with named phases tied to calendar months or dates, including when the legacy Teradata warehouses are decommissioned.

criteria.name: Exit plan
criteria.test: The proposal explains how Acme gets all of its data back if the contract ends or is terminated: the data format, the timeline, and who bears the cost. All three must be stated.

criteria.name: Proof before signing
criteria.test: The proposal names at least one comparable existing customer as a reference AND offers a concrete proof step before signature (a reference call or a proof-of-concept).

criteria.name: Power BI integration
criteria.test: The proposal confirms native Power BI integration and says how it works (for example a named connector or adapter).
